description: Lists an app's end users (not the developer or the team), paged, with the total: each with `_id` (the userId the other user tools take), email, name, language, stats, flags and ban state. One user's whole record: neblla_get_user; everyone with all their data: neblla_export_users. More: neblla_get_llms tools/list_users

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

emailFilter.description: Part of the email or name, 3+ characters, any case; ignored with withCommunicationsOnly.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

withCommunicationsOnly.description: true: only users with inbox messages.

name: neblla_list_users
title: List an app's users
